diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~12% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.15), which favours a robust combination.
